description: This file defines the AzureQueueAdapter class, an implementation of the IQueueAdapter interface, which manages Azure Queue storage integration for Orleans stream provider. It handles queue message batching, queue initialization, and provides methods for creating receivers and sending message batches.

classes.name: AzureQueueAdapter
classes.description: Implements the IQueueAdapter interface to facilitate message queuing with Azure Storage queues within Orleans stream providers.

methods.name: AzureQueueAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AzureQueueAdapter with necessary dependencies and configuration options.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates an instance of IQueueAdapterReceiver for a specified queue.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously enqueues a batch of stream events into the Azure Queue, initializing the queue if it does not already exist.
